notes.title: A Rayland Sequence
notes.content:
Hello dear friends!

It is with great happiness that we announce our newest game, [b]Rayland 2[/b].

After several improvements from player feedback on the first Rayland, we thought of a new game that already included everything we got right and everything that was improved on the first Rayland. In addition to restructuring and modifying the entire way the player moves the repeaters/reflectors of the lasers, lasers of different colors have also been added that must hit the targets of their respective colors, we have slightly modified some puzzle mechanics in the game to differentiate this second game of the first Rayland and create a new gaming experience for all players.

[h3]Please, consider add Rayland 2 to your [b]Wishlist[/b]![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271000/Rayland_2/
